purpose: The one line an AI agent writes to say how long until it needs the person again, its seven values, and how a loosely written value is snapped to one of them.
namedChanges: snapToValue moved from timeLine.ts to src/timeValues.ts, and the scale points (TIME_MARKS, TimeMark, the eight points, positionOf) moved there from timeScale.ts; names and behaviour unchanged; TIME_TOP_MS is private in the unit (exported in the app);
isTimeValue is added (true only for a string that is exactly one of the seven values);
comments: the header of src/timeValues.ts is new, the import in src/timeLine.ts reads from ./timeValues; no other code changed;

stays in the app (the app will import TIME_MARKS and positionOf from this unit): the bar's run and what only the bar needs, startRun, reEstimate, TimeRun, viewRun, TimeLeftView, msAt, leftText, overText, TIME_TOP_MS, TIME_DONE_POSITION, and the history of estimates;

tests: the snapToValue tests of timeLine.test.ts moved to src/timeValues.test.ts, the TIME_DONE_POSITION line of the TIME_MARKS test stayed in the app, imports fixed in the four moved test files; qatimeScale.test.ts is not moved (it tests the bar's run and the history).
